title: 生命・応用バイオ学入門とキャリアデザイン
subtitle: Introduction to Life and Applied Biosciences and Career Design
educationalGoal: Our college aims to nurture understanding and analytical ability of chemical and biological phenomena and to cultivate chemical and biotechnological engineers. In this course, you will understand the significance of learning chemistry, biology and their application fields, and the roles of engineers in related industrial fields. The objective of this course is to acquire the ideas necessary to achieve your future goals in your individual specialized field.
advice:
1.System of bioscience and chemistry
  Understand the curriculum flow chart for 4 years.
2.Application fields of bioscience
  Systematic study of bioscience can be applied to a wide range of industries.
3.Introduction to research fields and fostering scientific thinking abilities
  In this course, you will understand three areas of study: biotechnology, brain science, and genetic
  engineering.
4.State-of-the-art research introduced by professors at the Department
5.General exercise
  Writing assignments should be submitted to the Portfolio.
requiredKnowledge: No prerequisites. Be sure to prepare for and review the class every week.

activityGoals.body: Ability to learn independently based on understanding the roles of bioscience and chemistry.
Ability to learn independently based on understanding of the educational objectives of this Department.
Ability to explain the significance of studying at university.
Ability to explain the roles of bio-engineers in the related fields of bioscience.
Ability to consider the future development of bioscience fields logically and explain it properly.
Ability to describe your career plans and future dreams aimed at contributing to the community.

Ability to describe your future contribution as engineers, technicians and researchers in your own words. Ability to propose a 4-year learning plan and future career plan based on an understanding of the significance of learning at university. Ability to communicate these plans and future prospects properly with others.

              Our college aims to nurture understanding and analytical ability of chemical and biological phenomena and to cultivate chemical and biotechnological engineers. In this course, you will understand the significance of learning chemistry, biology and their application fields, and the roles of engineers in related industrial fields. The objective of this course is to acquire the ideas necessary to achieve your future goals in your individual specialized field.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              1.System of bioscience and chemistry
  Understand the curriculum flow chart for 4 years.
2.Application fields of bioscience
  Systematic study of bioscience can be applied to a wide range of industries.
3.Introduction to research fields and fostering scientific thinking abilities
  In this course, you will understand three areas of study: biotechnology, brain science, and genetic
  engineering.
4.State-of-the-art research introduced by professors at the Department
5.General exercise
  Writing assignments should be submitted to the Portfolio.
